title: Val3dityError
description: Reply of the val3dity image other than 200 (3D-74): 400 BAD_REQUEST (body not a validate-request), 404 NOT_FOUND (unknown route), 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 500 VALIDATOR_FAILED (val3dity did not exit 0 or wrote no report), 504 VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT. The service adapter treats every non-200 reply, a refused connection and a timeout as a port failure: the promise rejects and the service answers 503 UNAVAILABLE, model unchanged (spec §2.4; 3D-ADR-0008 decision 1).
$comment: D-446. [P] Codes and member names; `code` is bound to the HTTP status. The size limit and timeout values are image settings (environment), not contract fields.
